title: Textbook first London touch of the dPOC
summary: The dPOC had built a huge node all through Asia. In London, price traded away from it, then came back down for the first time at 02:37 ET. The dPOC held almost to the tick and hit 1:1 within a couple of minutes.
notes: The developing profile started at 18:00 ET. Through the Asia session, NQ rotated in a tight range and built a huge node of volume, with the dPOC sitting right in the middle of it around 27,218. By London, it had over 8 hours of volume behind it.
After the London open at 02:00 ET, price pushed up and away from the dPOC towards the ONVAL. London hadn't touched the dPOC yet.
Around 02:37 ET, price dropped back to the dPOC for the first time in London. Price came down to it, so the trade was long: limit at 27,217.75, stop at 27,194, target at 27,241.25. That's 1:1.

The dPOC held almost to the tick. Price snapped back up, hit the 1:1 within a couple of minutes, then kept going all the way up through the ONVAL. The touch in late Asia doesn't count: The Guard is the first touch in the London session.
